disabled.description: Whether or not to disable the tag

readOnly.description: Works just like disabled but keeps the same styles as if it were active

renderDismissButtonLabel.description:
Providing this prop renders a close button and makes the Tag dismissible.
The value is used as the close button's screen reader label.
Clicking the close button calls `onDismiss`.

onDismiss.description: Called when the close button is clicked.

renderIcon.description:
Add an SVG icon to the left of the Tag text. Do not add icons directly as
children. When using Lucide icons, Tag will automatically pass the
appropriate size prop based on the Tag's `size`.

href.description: If you provide an `href`, the Tag body renders as a link (`<a>`).

margin.description:
Valid values are `0`, `none`, `auto`, and Spacing token values,
see https://instructure.design/layout-spacing. Apply these values via
familiar CSS-like shorthand. For example, `margin="general.spaceMd auto"`.

elementRef.description: Provides a reference to the underlying html root element
